question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH jan_jun_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
),
jul_dec_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
),
jan_jun_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jan_jun_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
jul_dec_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jul_dec_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_jun_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jul_dec_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec;
action.metrics: repeat customers in Jan–Jun 2025, repeat customers in Jul–Dec 2025
repeat customers in Jan–Jun 2025, repeat customers in Jul–Dec 2025
action.answer: There were 95,048 repeat customers in January–June 2025 and 96,514 repeat customers in July–December 2025. Repeat status was evaluated separately within each half-year period. July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025.
action.reason: The counts were determined by identifying customers with more than one order in each respective period. July–December 2025 had 1,466 more repeat customers than January–June 2025.

final_answer: There were 95,048 repeat customers in January–June 2025 and 96,514 repeat customers in July–December 2025. Repeat status was evaluated separately within each half-year period. July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025.
